notifications.title: Starlink long video: three thumbnails ready for Test & Compare
notifications.detail: L-20261123-21 'How Does Starlink's Flat Dish Aim Without Moving?' ships with thumbnail A ('No motor', the dish taken apart, 9/10) and has B ('Bent beams', 8/10) and C ('It never turns', 8/10). YouTube's Test & Compare has no API, so only you can run it.
notifications.fix: 1. After it is published, open the video in YouTube Studio. 2. Details -> Thumbnail -> Test & compare. 3. Upload thumbnail.png, thumbnail-b.png and thumbnail-c.png from channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/videos/L-20261123-21/.
